purpose: Collect descriptive manual repetitions without inferring unavailable provider metadata.
collection_rules: Run each condition in a new independent conversation when possible.
Preserve the complete literal response before classification.
Use unknown for served_model, temperature, sampling, or other_sampling when unavailable.
Use true for conversation_independent only when the operator can confirm it.
Do not copy credentials, tokens, private connection strings, or hidden reasoning into the record.
Do not merge repetitions or overwrite a prior response.
A missing or interrupted run is recorded as incomplete, not PASS or FAIL.
Follow the protocol in manual-repetition-protocol.md for every record.

prohibited_claims: statistical superiority or equivalence between models
causal attribution to memory, criteria, or Socratic challenges
memory promotion based on these records alone
any claim depending on unknown sampling/temperature/served_model
supported_claims: identification of qualitative differences in recovery detail

per_record_fields: human_intervention (prompt_edit | response_edit | metadata_edit | escalation | rejection | none)

suite_limitations.valid_as: literal descriptive evidence of model behavior under supplied prompts
not_valid_as: causal test of memory, criteria, or Socratic mechanisms
basis for memory promotion or dogma amendment
basis for claims about behavior under different sampling/temperature/provider
root_causes: sampling, temperature, served_model unknown for most records
n=1 per case per condition per model in completed round
suite too small and narrow for definitive claims even at n=3
conditions_to_lift_limitations: automated provider integration with verifiable sampling/temperature/served_model
larger n per case with paired statistical tests
human-labeled subsets for classifier agreement validation

required: do not merge or overwrite repetitions
classify with case-specific classifier not manually
protocol_compliance.violation_consequence: record downgraded to unverified and excluded from aggregate analysis
